2123584500651508039.en_summary: Presented $MRVL for $LITE merger as example of what goes wrong using own stock to buy another. MRVL dropped -45% in over a month, cutting +24% premium for LITE to -41% discount. Massive dilution and arbitragers. Same dynamic likely when $SPCX offers +24% premium for $TSLA using SPCX stock: short-term pop then downward pressure. LITE now down -41% to $535 from $914 pre-deal. TSLA at $374 +24% could be -25% less within a month due to dilution.
2123584500651508039.zh_summary: 將 $MRVL 收購 $LITE 作為用自己股票買另一家公司出錯的例子。一個多月內 MRVL 下跌 -45%，將對 LITE 的 +24% 溢價變成 -41% 折扣。巨大稀釋和套利者。$SPCX 用 SPCX 股票對 $TSLA 提供 +24% 溢價時可能同樣動態：短期上漲後向下壓力。LITE 從交易前 914 美元跌至 535 美元，下跌 -41%。TSLA 在 374 美元 +24% 可能因稀釋在一個月內低 25%。
